prose: The Financial Times reports GM plans to move its listing from the NYSE to the Nasdaq on November 17, part of a push under Tesla veteran Sterling Anderson to use AI to speed up its development cycle. The defection is another blow for the Big Board as its tech-focused rival attracts some of the world's most valuable companies.
highlights: GM switches from NYSE to Nasdaq on November 17
Framed as part of an AI-driven development-cycle push under Sterling Anderson
Another high-profile defection from the Big Board
